findings.title: Package bundle carries only a HEAD ref; refs/heads/* fetch imports nothing, so every /package and every fix-round unbundle fails
findings.fix: package.sh: checkout -B ossbot-change; bundle create refs/heads/ossbot-change ^ROUND_BASE; gatekeeper requires list-heads == exactly refs/heads/ossbot-change and fetches it to refs/ossbot/r<rev>; unbundle fetches the same ref; test with the real package.sh

findings.title: Writable volume mountpoints inherit root:root 0755 via Docker copy-up and /tmp tmpfs is noexec; UID 10001 cannot write /io/output, /snap, /run/exec, /work/cache or exec /tmp binaries
findings.fix: Dockerfile install -d -o 10001 -g 10001 -m 0700 for /work /io/output /run/exec /snap /home/agent; --tmpfs /tmp:rw,exec,... for code-running profiles only; filter allows exec only for those profiles; [VERIFY] copy-up on Docker 29; sandbox test S-perm-1

findings.title: Operator import is infeasible: gatekeeper has no sandboxd access, package profile has no network to clone, VALIDATING skips fetch, bundle_path is a confused-deputy path read
findings.fix: ossctl uploads bundle bytes; gatekeeper validates (single head, prerequisites == base_sha, base ancestor) and stores under gatekeeper/imports; worker GET import-bundle; IMPORTED->FETCHING(W)->FETCHED->unbundle->IMPLEMENTED(W, source=operator)->VALIDATING

findings.title: Fix-round failures on a live PR go terminal, orphaning the open PR (maintainer_can_modify makes branch_moved routine)
findings.fix: When pr_number is set, FAILED/ABANDONED edges from working states and PACKAGING become ->WATCHING with state_reason fix_round_failed; terminal only via human 'Stop watching'; branch_moved sets watch_rounds=max and notifies; state-machine tests

findings.title: Recovery of a submission interrupted by crash, pause or kill is unspecified; nothing forbids auto-continuing writes after resume
findings.fix: Control-state check before fork, push and PR; on interruption -> SUBMIT_FAILED (interrupted) with fresh-approval Retry; on start reconcile executing actions by reads only; never resume writes automatically; tests for kill between push and PR and restart reconciliation

findings.title: Unique (upstream, issue_number) blocks re-attempts after DRY_RUN_DONE/FAILED, so the dry-run-then-live flow cannot reprocess an issue; re-discovery rules unstated
findings.fix: Partial unique index over non-terminal states; deterministic re-discovery rules (never after REJECTED/MERGED/CLOSED/policy SKIPPED; after DRY_RUN_DONE only when dry-run off; after FAILED/ABANDONED/EXPIRED after 7-day cooldown); discover tests

findings.title: Sandbox change.patch vs gatekeeper patch byte-compare is unspecified (no sandbox command, git-version signature, diff config) and a mismatch pauses the pipeline
findings.fix: One fixed format-patch command with --no-signature --full-index and pinned diff config on both sides; anomaly compares git patch-id --stable; binding patch_sha256 over that exact command; tests for version-only difference vs content difference

findings.where: §15.1 tool-surface allowlist and runtime check, §23 item 13
findings.title: Hermes Tool Search (enabled: auto) defers plugin/curated tools behind tool_search/tool_describe/tool_call bridges, so the model-visible surface can differ from /v1/toolsets or trigger a kill on every start
findings.fix: Render tools.tool_search.enabled: off [VERIFY]; surface check forbids bridge tools; fake test returning bridge tools -> kill; add to §23 item 13

findings.title: Hermes Kiro ACP session (key, hermes.env readable, web_public) relies on unverified modeId selecting ossbot-chat with no fail-closed check or probe gate
findings.fix: Adapter requires returned current mode == ossbot-chat (and advertised tools subset of web_search/web_fetch where exposed) else refuses and gatekeeper soft-kills hermes_kiro_surface; Hermes-side research_deny-style probe gating the relay; ACP contract test for mode mismatch

findings.title: Hermes installed via unpinned curl|bash website installer before the tag pin; unpinned code runs as the key-holding uid
findings.fix: git clone --depth 1 --branch v0.22.2, verify peeled commit from versions.lock, run the tag's setup-hermes.sh / uv sync --frozen against its uv.lock; same path for upgrades

findings.title: First-start ordering of probe gate vs empty model catalog unspecified; list_models is gated by probes whose model source is undefined (possible deadlock)
findings.fix: Exempt list_models from the probe gate and run it in a kiro_core-only catalog profile; probes use resolve() after first catalog refresh; fixed order list_models -> catalog -> probes -> jobs; tests

findings.title: Duplicate table header row breaks the systemd units table
Duplicated plugin bullet and duplicated ossbot-resume sentence
Summarizer repo_mode conflicts (snapshot vs none); snapshot helper called package profile but labelled snapshot
findings.fix: Summarizer repo_mode none, listed in §10.2 exceptions; use 'snapshot' consistently

findings.title: ossctl resume under full kill targets an API whose gatekeeper is stopped
findings.fix: Use API when /v1/health answers, else TTY confirm + sudo ossbot-resume; FYI on next gatekeeper start from a resume log entry

findings.title: Filter refuses create but not start while killed/paused
findings.fix: Refuse POST /containers/{id}/start under the same condition

findings.title: Probe tuple omits sandbox-full digest although snapshot.sh and execd live there
findings.fix: Add sandbox_full_digest to probe_key and the safety_probes primary key

findings.title: Strict schema would soft-kill on documented extra fields (label, description, configured)
findings.fix: extra=ignore with required name, enabled, tools

findings.title: Kiro V3 Tool Search may change MCP tool ids used in --trust-tools
findings.fix: Add [VERIFY] to §23 item 5, assert in coder_surface probe, disable via cli.json if a key exists
